cards.ex: We decided to ferry across to the island instead of flying.
cards.exUz: Uchish o'rniga orolga paromda o'tishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Paromda bir tomondan boshqa tomonga suv orqali o'tish.

cards.ex: As soon as he arrived, he made a beeline for the buffet table.
cards.exUz: U kelishi bilanoq, darhol bufet stoliga to'g'ri bordi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri, hech qanday chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz biron joyga borish.

cards.ex: I saw her zipping around town on her new electric scooter.
cards.exUz: Men uni yangi elektr skuteri bilan shaharda tez aylanib yurganini ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson harakatlanish, odatda kichik transport vositasida.

cards.ex: It was difficult to navigate through the narrow, crowded streets.
cards.exUz: Tor va gavjum ko'chalarda yo'nalishda yurish qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki murakkab hududda yo'l topish.

cards.ex: The new transportation project is expected to jump-start the local economy.
cards.exUz: Yangi transport loyihasi mahalliy iqtisodiyotni jonlantirishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiy o'sishni tezlashtirish yoki rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: The storm blew the ship off course.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron kemani yo'ldan adashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan yo'nalishdan yoki rejalashtirilgan yo'ldan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: We had to make changes to the itinerary on the fly.
cards.exUz: Biz marshrutga harakatda o'zgartirishlar kiritishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oldindan rejalashtirilmagan holda biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: He's been logging some serious miles on his motorcycle this summer.
cards.exUz: U yozda mototsiklda juda ko'p yo'l bosdi.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasida ko'p masofani bosib o'tish.

cards.ex: The city becomes a gridlock city during the holidays.
cards.exUz: Shahar bayram kunlarida tiqilinch shaharga aylanadi.
cards.uzDef: Transport harakati to'xtab qolgan shahar.

cards.ex: The project is now progressing under its own steam.
cards.exUz: Loyiha hozirda o'z kuchi bilan rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa hech kimning yordamisiz, o'z kuchi bilan harakatlanish.

cards.ex: The station is just a hop, skip, and a jump from my house.
cards.exUz: Stansiya mening uyimdan juda yaqin.
cards.uzDef: Juda qisqa masofa, juda yaqin joy.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to catch the early train.
cards.exUz: Agar erta poezdga ulgurmoqchi bo'lsak, tezroq harakatlanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakatlanishni boshlash, shoshilish.

cards.ex: The traffic was so bad, we were just crawling along.
cards.exUz: Tirbandlik shunchalik yomon ediki, biz faqat sekin sudraldik.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin harakatlanish, odatda tirbandlikda.

cards.ex: The hotel provides a shuttle service to the airport.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona aeroportga avtobus xizmatini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki joy o'rtasida doimiy ravishda qatnaydigan transport xizmati.

cards.ex: After a short break, the band is on the road again.
cards.exUz: Qisqa tanaffusdan so'ng, guruh yana yo'lda.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilishni yoki ishlash uchun yo'lga chiqishni boshlash.

cards.ex: The bicycle is a cheap and healthy means of transport.
cards.exUz: Velosiped - arzon va sog'lom transport vositasi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan ikkinchi joyga borish uchun ishlatiladigan usul.

cards.ex: We're flying by the seat of our pants on this project, but it seems to be working.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihada tajriba asosida ishlayapmiz, lekin u ishlayotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, tajriba va instinktga tayanib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The project is finally getting underway after months of planning.
cards.exUz: Loyiha nihoyat bir necha oylik rejalashtirishdan so'ng boshlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boshlash, harakatga kelish, yo'lga tushish.

cards.ex: The city is implementing traffic calming measures to improve safety.
cards.exUz: Shahar xavfsizlikni yaxshilash uchun harakatni tinchlantirish choralarini ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Transport harakatini sekinlashtirish uchun mo'ljallangan chora-tadbirlar.

cards.ex: He jumped the lights and nearly caused an accident.
cards.exUz: U qizilda o'tib ketdi va deyarli avtohalokatga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qizil chiroqqa e'tibor bermay, o'tib ketish.

cards.ex: The pedestrian precinct is a great place to shop and relax.
cards.exUz: Piyodalar zonasi xarid qilish va dam olish uchun ajoyib joy.
cards.uzDef: Faqat piyodalar uchun mo'ljallangan hudud.

cards.ex: She's been at the helm of the company for ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yildan beri kompaniyani boshqarib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir tashkilotni yoki loyihani boshqaruvida bo'lish.

cards.ex: They reverse engineered the competitor's product to understand its technology.
cards.exUz: Ular raqobatchining mahsulotini texnologiyasini tushunish uchun teskari muhandislik qildilar.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni tahlil qilib, qanday ishlashini aniqlash.

cards.ex: The company hauls freight across the country by truck and train.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yuklarni mamlakat bo'ylab yuk mashinalari va poezdda tashidi.
cards.uzDef: Yuklarni katta masofaga tashish.

cards.ex: That road hog wouldn't let me pass.
cards.exUz: U yo'l egasi menga o'tishga ruxsat bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda boshqa haydovchilarga xalaqit beradigan haydovchi.

cards.ex: Many companies are jumping on the electric car bandwagon.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kompaniyalar elektromobil trendiga qo'shilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur narsaga qo'shilish, odatda muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun.

cards.ex: I hate driving with my dad; he's such a back-seat driver.
cards.exUz: Men otam bilan haydashni yomon ko'raman; u juda befoiz maslahatchi.
cards.uzDef: Haydovchiga kerak bo'lmagan maslahatlar beradigan yo'lovchi.

cards.ex: He hit the gas and sped away.
cards.exUz: U gazni bosdi va tezda uzoqlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobilni tezlashtirish uchun gaz pedalini bosish.

cards.ex: The company is struggling to keep pace with technological advancements.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya texnologik yutuqlar bilan tempni ushlashga qiynalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan bir xil tezlikda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The shipping lanes are heavily congested.
cards.exUz: Kemalar yo'li juda gavjum.
cards.uzDef: Kemalar muntazam ravishda foydalanadigan dengiz yo'llari.
